purpose: Teach: 連勝/指紋/まっとう/集う/体裁/課し/フランチャイズ/振込み

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、連勝、絶対、続けるためにも、社員、皆、本気で、絶対、頑張ろうね
lines.en: Our company is going to keep this winning streak going—all of us together, seriously.
lines.style: Bright, purposeful opening. Steady pace with conviction. A leader rallying the team without theatrics. Warm but professional. Slight emphasis on continuity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。指紋認証の導入、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、安心しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The fingerprint system rollout has given everyone real peace of mind. I'm genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Earnest and attentive. Measured pace, clear-eyed. The careful gratitude of someone who means what he's saying. No rush. Slight nod of recognition in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: まっとうな、本気で、絶対、ビジネス、絶対、心がけていきましょうね、本気で、絶対、社員、皆
lines.en: Let's keep running an honest business—all of us looking out for that together.
lines.style: Calm directive. Not commanding—more inviting. Settled tone. Emphasis falls on 'honest' with quiet weight. Trails slightly as if checking the team is with her.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員集う場、本気で、絶対、社員食堂、絶対、改装、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively renovating the staff cafeteria—a real gathering place for everyone.
lines.style: Measured report. Slight pride in the update. Steady tempo, no rush. The voice of someone presenting concrete progress. Warm but factual.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様への、本気で、絶対、体裁、絶対、保ちましょうね、本気で、絶対、社員、皆、絶対、心がけて
lines.en: Let's make sure we're always presenting ourselves well to our customers—all of us keeping that in mind.
lines.style: Clear expectation without harshness. Moderate pace, deliberate. The words carry equal weight. Slight lift on 'ourselves' to emphasize collective responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人に、本気で、絶対、ミッション、絶対、課しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've given our new hires clear missions and expectations. I'm grateful for the commitment.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Steady, confident delivery. Brief pause before 'grateful' to show reflection. The voice of someone overseeing structure with care.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: フランチャイズの拡大、本気で、絶対、検討中ですよね、絶対、楽しみよ
lines.en: We're looking at franchise expansion right now—it's an exciting prospect.
lines.style: Lighter energy than before. Forward-leaning enthusiasm without losing composure. Slightly faster pace. The voice brightens on 'exciting' with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。月末の振込み、本気で、絶対、ミスなく、絶対、確認、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making absolutely sure end-of-month transfers are processed without error. Precision is our priority.
lines.style: Meticulous and assured. Deliberate pace, almost careful. Each phrase lands with small weight. Quiet confidence in procedure. No uncertainty.
